notes: Fixed a bug where leaving the app while music was playing could kill playback:the self-update engine used to defer an incoming update to the moment you close the app, then apply it immediately on background, reloading the app and cutting the song off. It now waits until the song actually pauses or ends (while backgrounded), so the music keeps playing when you leave the app
A downloaded-but-deferred update is offered again right when you start playing a song:the update sheet appears with Install now / Install later, so you always stay in control of when it applies
The update-ready toast now fires at most once per version,so it can't nag you every time the app re-checks in the background

Folding-phone fix: un-folding the screen no longer fires an update check every time (they got debounced into one quiet check 6s after the screen settles), so update checking can't fight playback or drain the battery on foldables

Export never says Library too big anymore: even on devices that can't stream straight to a file, the zip is now assembled chunk-by-chunk into one Blob — no giant single in-memory buffer — so full-library exports that used to fail with Array buffer allocation failed now succeed
